description: Zonas wifi públicas is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Alcobendas. Municipality of Alcobendas. Distribution of public Wi-Fi zones in the municipality. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Alcobendas. The portal shows the English title as "Public Wi-Fi areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Alcobendas. Its keywords include wifi, zonas wifi. The listing shows 3 download or service links in MS-EXCEL, SPREADSHEET, CSV. The listing shows 2022-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/odc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
